description: Zephyr driver source code for the LM75 temperature sensor, including initialization, temperature reading, power management, and device instantiation.

methods.name: lm75_reg_read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified register of the LM75 sensor via I2C.

methods.name: lm75_fetch_temp
methods.description: Fetches temperature data from the LM75 sensor and converts it to Celsius.

methods.name: lm75_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data based on the specified channel.

methods.name: lm75_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves the temperature value as a sensor_value structure.

methods.name: lm75_init
methods.description: Initializes the LM75 device, checks I2C readiness, and sets up power management.

methods.name: lm75_pm_action
methods.description: Handles power management actions for the device.
